thread:
jay: Heads-up — we want to deprecate the per-tenant streaming edgeflag `stream_v2` and fold behavior into the default streaming contract. Planning a 3-week migration window. Any immediate concerns about Tool/Function-call streaming semantics or compatibility? cc @claire

claire: 👋 Do we intend to change any of the delta event shapes? clients rely on `event.type` + `event.payload` today. If that's stable, migration is mostly a rollout toggle + docs.

suresh: main worry is mid-stream func-calls. If a request starts under v2 and flips to default, we need deterministic reassembly rules. Right now runtime assumes consistent event ordering and an `end_of_call` marker.

alex: quick proposal: enforce a compatibility shim in the runtime for the window. Shim will translate v2 deltas to canonical shape. After the window, we remove shim and bump schema minor (not breaking). Thoughts?

jay: sounds reasonable. Can we avoid a schema bump? product wants minimal churn for clients. Maybe we can keep wire format identical and only remove the flag toggle path.

pranav: product preference = no breaking schema changes. Migration notes, clear deprecation header in responses, and one-week beta opt-out sounds fine. Also need a support playbook for customers with custom stream reassemblers.

ellie: I'll draft docs + migration guide. Need concrete examples of the shim translation. Can someone paste a before/after delta sample?

suresh: here — example v2 chunk vs canonical: 
```
# v2 chunk (old):
{ "type": "delta", "meta": { "chunk_idx": 3, "tc": "toolcall" }, "payload": "..." }
# canonical (target):
{ "event": "delta", "detail": { "seq": 123, "phase": "toolcall_chunk", "payload": "..." } }
```
Shim mapping: meta.chunk_idx -> detail.seq, meta.tc -> phase enum. Also ensure `end_of_call` becomes `detail.phase: \"toolcall_end\"` and we emit `event: \"end\"`.

alex: runtime PR ready to add translation layer. I'll include flags to log untranslated shapes for 2 days in staging only.

jay: deploy-bot — can you schedule a canary for staging tomorrow 08:30 PST and add a smoke that exercises toolcall streaming?

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: staging/stream-shim at 2026-03-19T08:30:00-08:00. Smoke tests: convo-stream-smoke, funccall-reassembly. Notifications to #eng-oncall on fail. :robot_face:

claire: For clients: recommend they rely on `event` + `detail` fields and avoid peeking at `meta.*`. I'll add a compatibility note in the API spec.

pranav: timeline check — can we do staging canary -> 1 week opt-in in prod -> start deprecation countdown? Targeting full removal in 3 weeks if no regressions.

jay: yep. action items: (1) alex: runtime shim + logging PR, (2) ellie: migration guide + spec note, (3) claire: update API lint rules to flag `meta.*` usage, (4) suresh: test matrix for mid-stream flip cases. We'll reconvene async in 48h.

ellie: filing doc: https://redwood-internal.example/docs/streaming-deprecation-migration — will ping when draft is live.

alex: PR: https://git.internal/r/inference/runtime/pulls/432 — added shim and unit tests. Please review.

suresh: I'll add the smash tests to the matrix and run locally tonight. If I see weird reassembly, I'll post logs here.

jay: thanks all. quick thumbs if you're +1 to timeline so I can lock rollout: :thumbsup:

claire: :thumbsup:

suresh: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

ellie: :thumbsup:

jay: Great — closing thread for now, will reopen if any blocker pops up.
